newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: ISMA plans TRAX price information service.
newsitem.headline: ISMA plans TRAX price information service.

text.p: The International Securities Market Association (ISMA) on Thursday said it would launch an on-line service giving price information on traded securities.
Through its trade confirmation system TRAX, ISMA will provide a traded price service from August 4 of this year.

Over 3,500 securities reported to TRAX will be covered, and users will be able to get the highest, lowest and average price for each of the last five days for which a trade on that security has been reported, Royston Lambert, managing director of ISMA Limited, said at ISMA's annual general meeting.

"For the first time actual traded price information for the previous business day will be available to TRAX users," Lambert said. "Using a standard browser users can look at specific issues or a selection."
TRAX was introduced in 1989 and now handles trading volumes of between 40,000 and 50,000 transactions per day.
